import datetime,json,pathlib,subprocess,sys,time
out=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
launch=json.loads((out/'launch.json').read_text())
start=time.time()
def status(state,**kw):
 (out/'status.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(state=state,pid=__import__('os').getpid(),updated_utc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),elapsed_seconds=time.time()-start,**kw),indent=2)+'\n')
status('running')
try:
 result=subprocess.run(launch['command'],cwd=launch['cwd'])
 if result.returncode:
  status('failed',returncode=result.returncode)
  sys.exit(result.returncode)
 summary=subprocess.run([launch['command'][0],'summarize_frozen_perception.py',str(out/'results.json'),'--output',str(out/'summary.json')],cwd=launch['cwd'])
 status('complete' if summary.returncode==0 else 'summary_failed',returncode=summary.returncode)
except BaseException as exc:
 status('failed',error=repr(exc))
 raise
